title: Television tastes and letters to Sammy Davis, Billy Eckstine and Lena Horne
summary: She watches news and Red Foxx's show, is annoyed that Sammy Davis and Billy Eckstine do not answer her letters, and says Lena Horne and her mother Edna always do.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Once in awhile. I watch television for the news. Now, I like Red Foxx, and I like --
What's that guy's name that -- huh?
Do you like Aunt -- the Aunt in

Oh, yeah, I think she's adorable. She's adorable. And I like -- I like Sammy, but I'm mad with Sammy because I've written him several letters and he didn't answer. And I know Sammy so well, he shouldn't put on the ritz with me, because I know him so well, see. And Billy Eckstine. I'm crazy to get in touch with him. I sent him a letter and sent it registered special and requested a return letter.
Well, I'm going to help you with that.

And he didn't -- and the letter came back just as it was. Now, sometimes they think you're begging, but I don't need anything from anybody, because I have preserved my health and I have saved my money, so I don't need any favors from anybody. I'm only trying to get in touch with Billy Eckstine because I would like to hear that song of his, 'If I Can Help Somebody'. That I'm always trying to do, as you know.

And that song has helped me a lot in my work, too, see? So I don't need anything. So anytime any of them get a letter from me, they can just open it and read it, because there's no begging. Because I'm sending everybody that I can think of that needed a little help, sending them

some money. So I hope they will get that. Now, one person that always answers my letters and is as sweet to me as she can be is Lena Horne. If I write Lena Horne she'll answer me right away. And I call her mother, Mrs. Edna Horne, and talk to her all the time. She's as sweet as she can be. Because she was in my first Broadway show with me.
